acceptance_criteria.criterion: composer test produces no PHPUnit class/filename mismatch warning and all 3 PHP parser tests execute
All existing tests continue to pass with zero regressions
composer analyze passes at PHPStan level 8

summary: Fixed BUG-1: CountryCurrency::isNumberValid() now uses === 1 instead of !== false with preg_match, correctly rejecting invalid strings like 'abc'.

Fixed BUG-2: CurrencyNumberInfo $decimals changed from int to string (constructor accepts int|string), getDecimals() now returns string, countDecimals() uses === '0' check. Leading zeros are preserved (e.g., '05' stays '05').
Fixed BUG-3: PHPParserTests.php class renamed from ParserPHPTest to PHPParserTests, restoring 3 previously skipped parser tests.
Updated CountryCurrencyInterface PHPDoc: isNumberValid() @param now includes null (accepted via empty() check).

Fixed pre-existing PHPStan errors: getSupportedLocaleNames() now casts result to string[], functions.php call_user_func() replaced with direct method calls, StringCollection SerializedStringCollection type fixed.

comments.note: CountryCurrencyInterface.isNumberValid() @param updated to include null — the implementation always accepted it via empty() but the contract was misleading.

CountryCurrency regex lacks \A anchor on alternatives 2 and 3, meaning isNumberValid() accepts strings with valid currency suffixes (e.g. '12.34.56' → true because '34.56' matches). This is documented in ValidationTests but not fixed — fixing the regex is a separate correctness task.
functions.php: replaced call_user_func() array-style calls with direct translate() invocations — cleaner, more IDE-friendly, and removes a PHPStan level-8 type error.
